name: com.lirisxr.nebula
description: Control a Nebula olfactory device from Unity over Serial (USB) or BLE. BLE is wired through the shared com.lirisxr.blebridge package, so it can coexist with StimulHeat in the same project.

samples.description: Contains a desktop OnGUI demo to connect to and command a Nebula device over Serial or BLE, switching transport from the toolbar.

Distance-triggered odor diffusion scripts ported from nebula-v2. No XR Toolkit dependency and no physics setup: NebulaPlayerHead registers the player head as the odor detector and NebulaOdorZone starts/stops diffusion on head-to-object distance, with an optional linear duty-by-distance mode. NebulaVRBootstrap connects the NebulaManager over BLE on start.
